notes.title: Backpack Twins is out!
notes.notes:
[b]Backpack Twins has been released![/b]

And we're celebrating with a launch discount, too!

[b]Any questions or feedback?[/b] Be sure to visit the game's [b]Community Hub[/b]!

notes.title: Final trailer and release date announcement
notes.notes:
I'm very glad to announce that [u][b]Backpack Twins will be released in August 16th![/b][/u]

Along with these news comes a [u][b]new trailer[/b][/u], be sure to check it out!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QN2-KJN_XhU

Do you like what you see? [u][b]Why not try the playable demo?[/b][/u] It has four full levels, that's easily about an hour of gameplay!

[u][b]What about wishlisting[/b][/u] the game while you're here? Memory is a fragile thing!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1049310/Backpack_Twins/

notes.title: Playable Demo is out!
notes.notes:
The [b]Playable Demo[/b] of [b][i]Backpack Twins[/i][/b] is now available for download at the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1049310/Backpack_Twins/]Store Page[/url][/b], try it out!

[b]Don't forget to add it to your wishlist[/b] so you can be notified when the game releases!

And to those who have already played the demo... were you able to 100% it?
